transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name is Grace. What can I do for you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. I've been charged a cancellation fee of a hundred and twenty pounds for switching my mobile contract to a SIM-only plan with you, and nobody told me there'd be a fee. I'm really not happy.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry, Hamid, an unexpected fee like that would upset anyone. Let's look at it now. Can you give me your PIN, please?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. When did you make the switch?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Last Tuesday, in the shop on the high street.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And did the shop assistant go through any paperwork or a summary of the new plan with you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: She printed a summary but I didn't read every line.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's understandable. Was your old contract still within the first twenty-four months?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I think it had about three months left.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. The fee is for ending the old phone contract early, but because you stayed with S-Net and moved to a SIM-only plan, it shouldn't apply. It was added by mistake.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So I don't have to pay it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No. I've removed the hundred and twenty pounds from your account just now, and you'll see a corrected bill in the next few days.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you check the app for me, and see whether the fee is gone from your balance?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the balance is back to normal now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, so the fee is removed and your plan is correct. Anything else I can help with today, Hamid?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Have a good day.
